### Changed
- `components.kagent.versionRange` is `0.1.x` (was `0.x`). kagent 0.2.0 flattens the upstream keys onto the chart root and takes no nested `kagent:` block, so the current wiring must not pick it up. The wiring change and the `0.2.x` range ship together in a later release. **No installation needs to act.** A BOM that pins `components.kagent.versionRange` inside `0.1.x` is unaffected.
